kitDescription: Eunhwa is a Fire SR Attacker with a 6-round magazine and a 20s Burst II. Each time she empties her magazine, she buffs herself with Charge Damage +37.28% and Charge Speed +15.53% for her first two shots of the next magazine, and simultaneously applies a DEF -29% debuff to her target for 5 seconds. Her burst deals a single hit of 85.62% of final ATK to the highest-ATK enemies (one hit on the single raid boss), applies a small DEF -2.43% debuff for 15 seconds, and grants all allies including herself +4.65% Critical Rate for 15 seconds. In practice her self-buffs give roughly a 2-of-6 shot duty cycle per magazine, and her burst cast lands just before Full Burst begins so it never receives the +50% Full Burst bonus.

skill1.explanation: Fires once per magazine dry-fire (~20x/180s), boosts exactly the first 2 shots of the next magazine at the kit ratio 287.28/250 (driver test pins to 9 decimal places), magazine 0 untouched. verdictRationale: No real gotchas. All six kit lines are FAITHFUL (4) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (2). The two DEF▼ lines are a genuine missing engine primitive (no enemy-DEF channel; boss DEF is the flat constant 140 that no debuff scales), but the gap is documented verbatim on the driver side, was pre-authorized as the honest-GAP contingency by the S2b reviewer, is behaviorally pinned against the damageTakenPct-laundering wrong model, and carries ~0 damage consequence at scope lock per the SSOT's own DEF analysis — so it is not an engine-core failure. Convergence is real and multi-family: the blind S5 suite runs 15/0-fail/2-pre-declared-GAP-skips against the shipped override unmodified, the S6 blind override is byte-equivalent on every modeled line, and the two sharpest traps (round-count windows that would go silently inert as durationSec:2 across the 2.68s reload; burstCast vs fullBurstEnter keying) were identified independently by S2b and encoded identically by driver and both blind agents. Discrimination holds everywhere: passive-vs-lastBullet, per-shot trigger, strip A/Bs, nuke half/double linearity, fullBurstEnter counterfactual, and the laundering pin all have teeth. Same-model residuals the owner should spot-check: (1) the durationShots consumption phase — the driver pins behaviorally that the triggering last bullet does NOT consume one of the two rounds and the window covers exactly the first two shots of the next magazine; all agents share this reading and it is unmeasured against real footage (⚑-class, low blast radius); (2) the cadence tuple (60f charge / 161f reload / 6 ammo) is datamined and drives both S1 uptime and the (unmodeled) S2 cadence — flagged by S6, shared by everyone; (3) the 10-target fan-out and DEF-debuff payload are structurally unobservable at scope lock and remain standing GAPs if the engine ever gains those channels.
